simple.meaning: מִטָּה (miṭṭâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a bed (as extended) for sleeping or eating; by analogy, a sofa , litter or bier.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 47:31. The surrounding context includes family line, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִטָּה (H4296) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: מִטָּה (miṭṭâh) / H4296 is traced through Genesis 47:31, Genesis 48:2, Genesis 49:33, Exodus 7:28 with generated occurrence evidence.

When the messengers came in, behold, the teraphim was in the bed, with the pillow of goats’ hair at its head.
But he refused, and said, “I will not eat.” But his servants, together with the woman, constrained him; and he listened to their voice. So he arose from the earth and sat on the bed.

But Jehosheba, the daughter of king Joram, sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him away from among the king’s sons who were slain, even him and his nurse, and put them in the bedroom; and they hid him from Athaliah, so that he was not slain.

But Jehoshabeath, the king’s daughter, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stealthily rescued him from among the king’s sons who were slain, and put him and his nurse in the bedroom. definitions.short: a bed (as extended) for sleeping or eating; by analogy, a sofa , litter or bier
definitions.full: H4296. mittah מִטָּה noun feminine couch, bed ( place of reclining ; מטותם Ecclus 48:6); — absolute מִטָּה Amos 3:12 14 t.; construct מִטַּת 2Kin 4:21 ; suffix מִטָּתִי Psa 6:7 , מִטָּתֶ֑ךָ Exodus 7:28, מִטָּתוֺ 2Sam 4:7 6 t.; plural מִטּוֺת absolute 2Kin 11:2 ; 2Chr 22:11 , construct Amos 6:4 ; Est 1:6 ; — couch, bed , common article of furniture 2Kin 4:10 , compare 4:21 ; 4:32 ; 1Kin 17:19 , for repose, especially at night, or in illness Gen 47:31 (J; הַמּ ׳ראֹשׁ ), compare 48:2 (J), 49:33 (P), Psa 6:7 ; Prov 26:14 ; 2Chr 24:25 (probably), and for sitting, or reclining by day 1Sam 28:23 ; 1Kin 21:4 ; מ ׳מְּאַת Amos 3:12 ; seat of King Solomon Song 3:7 ; in bed-chamber ( מִשְׁכָּב חֲדַר ) Exodus 7:28 (J), 2Sam 4:7 ; sometimes portable 1Sam 19:15 compare 19:13 ; 19:16 , hence = bier 2Sam 3:31 ; sometimes high 2Kin 1:4 , 6 , 16 ( שָׁם עָלָה opposed to מִן יָרַד ); sometimes costly, (with frames) of ivory Amos 6:4 ; for reclining at feasts, made of gold and silver Est 1:6 ; compare ׳מ כְּבוּדָּה Ezek 23:41 glorious couch ; הַמִּטּוֺת חֲדַר 2Kin 11:2 2Chr 22:11 (see חֶדֶר ). — compare also מִשְׁכָּב ( שׁכב ), עֶרֶשׂ .
